Badges

Every mod's badges, in its own colors and in four styles. The live ones (downloads, newest version, Minecraft versions) are drawn again every few hours from CurseForge, Modrinth and the update checks; a number that can't be had yet is left off. Pick one to copy it, or change it in the builder for an address of your own.

Builder

Change any badge's style, colors (gradients too), words and size, and get an address that's ready to use. It's drawn as it's asked for, live numbers and all, so it keeps up like the rest.
